summary: Scrolling and touch input received a broad round of improvements: Firefox now handles device scaling more accurately, respects CSS `overscroll-behavior` throughout chained scrolling and flings, and behaves more reliably when gestures change direction or a page’s layout shifts. Video display was also strengthened on macOS so DRM-protected frames stay protected, while Wayland and other compositor paths gained updates for newer buffer and HDR color-handling approaches.
